methodology.blockThresholds: Median outfield distance from own goal: low <36% of length, high >62%, otherwise mid; at least 7 assigned tracks. Not FIFA official classifications.
methodology.pressure: Within 12 m, observed velocity toward current ball >1.5 m/s. Not inferred from distance alone.
methodology.possession: Nearest team within 4.0 m, at least 0.75 m closer than an opponent, sustained 0.2 s. The last observed team may carry for at most 1.2 s across a pass or detector miss; longer gaps remain unknown.
methodology.space: Nearest-player regions on a 24×16 grid, not a calibrated pitch-control probability.
methodology.advice: Coaching hypotheses triggered by measurements, not a learned strategy or guaranteed outcome. Pass lanes omit ball flight, reaction time and offside.
methodology.reactions: Lateral displacement over 1-2 s compares observed endpoints; it does not establish causation or predict a future response.

ratingModel.limitations: Relative activity score for this clip. It is not a full-match performance rating and does not infer goals, assists, passes, shots, or xG.
